title.en: ChatGPT says 1.2 billion people visit weekly. Will image-making become an ad break?
title.zh: ChatGPT每周12亿人用：画张图，也要插广告了？

summary.en: OpenAI plans a US visual-ad test during image generation later in October. It says the ads will remain separate from generated images and will not influence answers.
summary.zh: OpenAI计划10月晚些时候在美国试投生成图片时的视觉广告，并称广告与生成图片分开、不会影响回答。

title.en: He can switch neurons with light. How did Karl Deisseroth miss the Nobel call?
title.zh: 他能用光开关神经细胞，却漏接诺奖电话：戴瑟罗斯做对了什么？

summary.en: Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel share the 2026 medicine Nobel for optogenetics. The work changes how scientists test brain circuits; it is not a universal cure or mind-reading tool.
summary.zh: 戴瑟罗斯、赫格曼与纳格尔共享2026年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。光遗传学改变了研究脑回路的方法，但不是万能疗法或读心术。
